QuestInfo.name: Twinkling Treasure Star
QuestInfo.0: Treasure Island fell from the sky! You need to collect Stardusts to enter this amazing place teeming with treasure. Talk to Gaga for more info.
QuestInfo.1: Treasure Island fell from the sky! You need to collect Stardusts to enter this amazing place teeming with treasure. When you asked Gaga, he told you to collect 50 Stardusts from Maple World monsters for #b1 Twinkling Star#k, which you'll need to enter.
QuestInfo.2: You took 50 Stardusts to Gaga for 1 #bTwinkling Star#k that'll let you enter the treasure island. Talk to Gaga to enter the island.

0.0: Have you heard about the Treasure Island Star falling to Maple World from space? Everyone's clamoring to get in!
0.1: I've heard the only way to get inside is with a special item. \r\n\r\nAren't you curious?!

yes.0:
I knew you'd be excited. The star's crash spread Stardust all over Maple World. The monsters are positively coated in the stuff. Bring me #b50 Star Powders#k, and I'll create a Twinkling Star for you. It will allow you to enter.

Hows is it? Simple enough?
